data.title: Beachgate By Address
data.about:
An urban beachside oasis, beachgate By Address make your dream lifestyle a reality. Emaar Beachfront offers cosmopolitan living, a prime location, and luxury living with spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf and pristine sandy beaches. 

This luxurious collection of one, two, three, and four bedroom apartments and penthouses exudes elegance and sophistication.

characteristics_module.title: Your Own Luxury Resort
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Beachfront Location
  • Branded luxury 1 to 4 bedroom apartments and penthouses and duplex penthouses
  • Starting Price AED 2.9M
  • Flexible 80/20 Payment Plan
  • World-class amenities
  • Direct beach access
  • Handover 2026

location_tile.title: An Exclusive Beachfront Location
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
An exclusive island community, just steps from Dubai Harbour, Emaar Beachfront apartments are located within Dubai Harbour, the UAE’s new maritime center. You will enjoy breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Dubai Marina skyline from this hotel.

  • 05 Mins – Dubai Marina
  • 05 Mins – Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 15 Mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Mins – Dubai International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Beachgate by Address offers elegant 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses, blending luxury and sophistication with breathtaking views and premium finishes.
